scenes.heading: Workspace Overview
scenes.narration: The Databricks workspace is the web-based environment where you organize notebooks, data, and compute, and collaborate with your team.

scenes.heading: What lives in the workspace
bullets: Notebooks and folders for your code
Catalog browser for data and tables
scenes.narration: Notebooks and folders keep your code organized and shareable. The compute section is where you start clusters and SQL warehouses to run that code. And the catalog browser lets you explore the databases and tables you can query.

scenes.heading: A typical session
scenes.narration: You start by logging into the workspace in your browser. You open a notebook and attach it to a running cluster for compute. Then you run your code and see results, plots, and logs inline.

scenes.text: The workspace is the single collaborative UI that ties together your code, compute, and data assets.
scenes.narration: Think of the workspace as the single collaborative home that ties your code, compute, and data together.
